question: At what time and to whose abode must the ritual procession be conducted?
premises: The eighth lunar day is specified as the occasion.
The action is to occur during a portion of the night.
The prescribed destination is the house of Kāmeśvarī.
inference: On the eighth day, during the night portion, one should conduct the procession to the house of Kāmeśvarī.
uncertainties: The exact portion of the night intended by niśābhāge is not specified.
plain_english: And on the eighth day, during the night, one should lead the procession to the house of Kāmeśvarī.
